Lakbay means journey. Gunita means memory. Travel through the history of the Philippines, one period at a time.

Start the journey

A history worth traveling for

The Philippines has a rich and layered history, from its first settlers and ancient seafarers to centuries of colonial rule, a revolution for independence, the struggles of World War II, and the People Power Revolution that brought back democracy. Many of the places where this history happened are still standing today. You can walk through them, see them for yourself, and travel to them. This site follows these places in the order of the periods they belong to.
